# Frame Realm

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:FrameRealm`](gmeow-FrameRealm.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/FrameRealm>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The physical, virtual, or conceptual domain of a reference frame (e.g. terrestrial, indoor, celestial, virtual, measurement, currency, temporal, colourspace, linguistic).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:FrameRealm`](gmeow-FrameRealm.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the physical, virtual, or conceptual domain of a reference frame (terrestrial, celestial, currency, temporal, …) as a value individual.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the realm as a [`ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) subclass ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint the realm as a [`gmeow:FrameRealm`](gmeow-FrameRealm.md) individual and reference it from a frame via the functional [`gmeow:frameRealm`](../properties/gmeow-frameRealm.md).

### Examples

- ex:frameRealmTerrestrial a [`gmeow:FrameRealm`](gmeow-FrameRealm.md).
